<b>Infestation Operation</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The Wish only becomes available by first completing the <i>[[Rite of Rebirth]]</i> wish and acquiring the [[Cursed Crest]].

After [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] frees herself from the [[Chapel of the Witch]], various [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPCs]] advise talking to the [[Bell Hermit]] in [[Bellhart]], who tells Hornet the location of the home of the exiled physician [[Yarnaby]]. Yarnaby only opens her door while Hornet is Cursed. Once inside, she inspects Hornet and subsequently offers the services of her Extricator, which needs an upgrade before it can be used. Yarnaby then offers the wish to Hornet.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Yarnaby.png!Location in Greymoor
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Yarnaby 03.png!Yarnaby in Greymoor
}}

== Wish ==
[[File:Steel Spines.png|link=Steel Spines|left|thumb|100x100px]]

Hornet is tasked with acquiring the [[Steel Spines]] for Yarnaby's Extricator from the NPCs [[Crull and Benjin]] in [[Sinner's Road]], which can be purchased from them for {{R|160}}.

If the wish is started in [[Act 3]] (as Hornet is unable to progress to Act 3 while Cursed due to the <i>[[Twisted Child]]</i> ending), then Crull and Benjin are dead when Hornet reaches their home, allowing her to acquire the Steel Spines for free.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Crull and Benjin 01.png!Location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Sinner's Road 05.png!Crull and Benjin in Sinner's Road
}}

== Reward ==
{{Disclaimer|Completing this final stage of the wish makes the <i>[[Twisted Child]]</i> ending subsequently unobtainable on that [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]].}}
[[File:Witch Crest File.png|link=Witch Crest|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After returning to Yarnaby and giving her the Steel Spines, the wish completes. Following a short cutscene afterwards, Hornet is then rewarded with the Cursed Crest transforming into the [[Witch Crest]].

{{Clear}}
